topic: How we work: the tech stack we build with, and why
caption:
What do we actually build with? Here's our stack, layer by layer. 🧱

▸ Web: React and Next.js
▸ Mobile: React Native for iOS and Android
▸ Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, Python/FastAPI and .NET
▸ Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL and DynamoDB
▸ Cloud: AWS, Docker and CI/CD pipelines

We pick from proven tools based on your product and who will maintain it, not on hype. All delivered through our ISO-certified process.

Wondering which stack fits your project? DM us STACK and we'll tell you what we'd pick and why.

Save this for when you brief your dev team. 🔖
